fact_text: Ghani Dairies began in 2020 with 200 Holstein Friesian cows imported from the United States and is preparing a Pakistan Stock Exchange IPO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The group head, Hafiz Awais Ghani, said he leads about seven companies, of which Ghani Dairies, Ghani Mines and Ghani Himalaya Salt are the best known.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: At the 29 Jan 2026 interview the herd was over 2,600 animals and rising day by day through breeding, which makes an exact head count hard to keep.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The farm is at Noorpur Thal, about one hour's drive from Khushab, and the nearest very small town is about 7 km away.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The site was chosen for its distance from settlements, because live-animal farms need a disease-free area and the CEO said most airborne disease spreads only a few km.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: July and August are the stressful months for imported cows in the Thal area, so sheds must keep temperature controlled all year to limit heat stress.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Imported cows walking on concrete need soft bedding and pads, otherwise their hooves deteriorate and they stop walking, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO named livestock disease, including foot-and-mouth disease which has hit herds in several years, as the main downside risk for the dairy business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO argued that livestock diseases can only be eliminated in Pakistan with state action, since individual farms lack the power to control disease across a region.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: A herd this size cannot be milked by hand, so the farm uses milking parlours from a US milking-equipment maker (captioned 'Bomatic'), which the CEO said is one of the largest in the field.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Milk leaves the cow at about 33 to 36 degrees C through stainless-steel pipes over roughly 200 to 250 feet and is chilled to 3 degrees C within seconds; any delay spoils it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Feed is the main cost of a dairy farm; silage made from corn is the core, supplemented by Napier grass, Rhodes grass and alfalfa grown on the farm's own land.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Soybean, a feed input, is almost fully imported for the dairy sector, so the farm is testing substitutes that keep milk yield near 35 litres a day.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO plans to grow feed on its own land toward full self-reliance, because buying fodder from the market carries a 25 to 30 percent premium.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Each cow is expected to give about 35 litres of milk a day on average, provided animal health holds, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Each cow is a production unit, so the CEO said revenue depends mainly on the number of healthy animals, and growth comes from adding cows rather than from price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The farm holds about 700 acres, which the CEO said lets it expand the herd without buying land at prices that are rising.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The farm has installed a 1.6 MW solar system that the CEO said supplies about 50 to 60 percent of its electricity needs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO presented a target of becoming largely grid-free within one to two years as solar capacity is added.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO gave gross margin of about 15 to 16 percent and net margin of about 10 to 12 percent, varying by year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Management expects margins to stay stable, with a gain of one or two percentage points possible but not a large jump.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The company aims to raise about 2.5 billion rupees through the IPO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO said IPO proceeds will go only to the animals, a milking parlour, shed construction and allied items, with no other use planned.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Management plans to import 1,100 to 1,300 animals in 2026, subject to IPO proceeds and purchase timing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The herd is planned to double within about one year of the 29 Jan 2026 interview, a timeline the CEO gave loosely and which depends on IPO funds.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Management is showing investors 35 to 40 percent annual growth through 2030, and the CEO argued the business is easy to value because milk price and cost are both known.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Packaged milk is only about 2 to 4 percent of milk sold in Pakistan, and the rest moves through the informal gwala (milkman) system.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Large packaged-milk companies reportedly buy about 90 percent of their milk through the gwala system without traceability, and the CEO expects them to favour corporate-farm suppliers over time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The farm sells milk to large packaged-milk companies, which the CEO named as Nestle and Fauji Foods, with some earlier supply to Engro.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO said the business is not very competitive because demand exceeds supply and a supplier of reliable milk finds selling easy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: Packaged milk carries an 18 percent sales tax (GST), while loose milk sold through gwalas pays none, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO said the tax has widened the price gap between packaged and loose milk, pushing buyers back to loose milk and hurting larger packaged-milk players.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO urged the government to rationalise the tax, arguing that milk is a basic food and that several US states exempt it from tax.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO said the tax change helps the farm because its own GST input can be adjusted under the change, which the CEO said was not possible before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: If packaged-milk sales fell, demand for the farm's milk would fall too, though the CEO said no such drop is visible.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The CEO cited a Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government report, which he said he could not verify, claiming about 90 percent of milk given and sold in that province is adulterated.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)

fact_text: The company says it is Shariah-compliant and presented this as a reason for investors who want only Shariah-compliant stocks.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Ghani Dairies IPO in Pakistan: Price, Size and Growth Plans | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-29)
